description: Finds token contract addresses by symbol or name across chains using DexScreener search and verified lists. Returns matching tokens with chain, contract address, symbol, name, liquidity of largest pool, and verified list membership. Limit up to 25. Information only, not financial advice. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

q.description: Token symbol or name search query (e.g. PEPE, USDC)
